content: Enawenaneha Malta Nali
Wiyane watákoahenere waikohekoa najikinita waiyekehalaka womana. Hatyo iyolirotikoa tyaohenere nexare nika atyo Malta.
Nali tyaoniterenai waiye moka wiso. Oneta hoka tiha aka tyaonita hoka kalore fakihityaha.
Hoka Paulo xane olahisetya mowisati hoka tyoa xawatita ene irikatyaose hoka owi tekoahena watere nonitata hoka alalatyoa Paulo kahe hiye hoka tyalokene.

Hatyaoseta hatyo iyolirotikoa nali tyaoniterenai, waiyaha owi xalalatyoane Paulo kahe hiye hoka nexaha: — Exe haliti ala aijitaterehare. Maisa wainita one xaiya, xakore hoka maisaiya maxaisakita — nexaha.
Xakore hoka Paulo xaxakahisa hakahe hoka owi irikatyaose exoa hoka maisa xoare kihixita hahiye.

Wahakotyahitaha taita enomana, motyaite faka ihiye xamani, xoana wainihena rota xamanite aokahitaha. Wahakohenaha mene enomana hoka maisa xoana tyaonare hoka hawarehare ahekohenahitiyaha hoka nehenaha: — Kala enore — nexaha.
Hatyo haliyaseta Públio nexarexe kawaikoherere. Hatyo atyo iyolirotikoa tyaohenere xekohasehare. Waiye moka wiso hahanako hoka hanamaki ferakene wisaona ehanako.
Enexe hokakita hoka ehokotyoita taita kamakoa, watyahiseta exahe ityako hare kaweta. Hoka Paulo xane isoa hoka iraexatya enomana, hakahe ekaokakisa ihiye hoka aiyatelikihetene.
Hatyo najikinita tyotya hatyo iyolirotikoa nali hokakiterenai tyoaha hoka aiyatelikihenahitene.
Hatyaoseta nali tyaoniterenai kahare xoalini hare isaha womana. Wijiyehitiya hoka wiyanene niyahare tyotya waokitereharenai isaha womana.
Xaneha Malta ta Roma Xeta

Hanamali kaimare iyolirotikoa wisaohenere najikinita wijiyehitiya hatya kanowa Alexandria tare ako, “Haximarene Kakoa Haxawalita Tyaohenerenai” nexarexe ako. Hatyo kanowa atyo iyolirotikoa nali atyahaheta tihere tyoteneheta xahita.
Hatyaoseta wiyane wikaoka wenakalati Siracusa nali hoka hanamaki ferakene wisaona.

Hatyaoseta wijiyehitiya hoka wiyane wikaoka wenakalati Régio nali. Kamaetali hoka África maniyata hoholati hoholahena hoka hatyo hiyeta hinamaki ferakene kakoita wiyane wikaoka wenakalati Puzuoli nali.
Hatyo wenakalati nali haiyaharenai tyakekohatiyenai ana wiyane wikaoka hoka hasemanane wisaona ehaliyaha aokaha.

Wihinaeharenai Roma nali tyaoniterenai sema wikaokene hoka tyoa ahalakoatyaha wiso wenakalati Ápio nali, exahe wenakalati Hanama Betetyakalati aokahitere nali akiti tehitiya haiyaharenai ahalakoatya wiso. Paulo waiyahene hoka ihalahare Enore kakoa, exahe ihalahare tyaona.
Paulo Kaoka Roma Nali
Wiyane Roma nali wikaoka hoka Paulo halakisaha hoka haxaokala ximita tyaona. Xakore hoka hatya sorare kaxaikotene.

Hanamaki ferakene najikinita Paulo kawisa judeunai nityohalitiranai, Roma nali yerenai, ahalakoatyahene maheta. Ahohisakoatyakakoaha hoka nehena: — Nohinaeharenai, maisa nokahalakoiharexe wihinaeharenai kakoa, exahe maisa nokahalakoiharexe wawenanaho, wahetakomaniyere harenai aotyakihenere wiso kakoa. Xakore hoka judeunai berexotyaha natyo Jerusalém nali hoka Roma yerenai ana isaha natyo.
Hoka hatyonai axalisaha natyo hoka halakihenahitaha natyo aokowiha, maisa maxemerehareta nokaxaisaki aokahitaha hoka.

Xakore hoka judeunai atyo maisa nohalakisakiheta aokita ihiyeha. Hatyo hiyeta naxahene hoka Kalorexe ana notyoa hoka sema notahi maheta. Xakore hoka maisa atyo natyohotyalihare niraeharetya maheta xini.
Hatyo hiyeta naxa xiso, nowaiyeheta xiso, exahe wirae kakoa maheta. Israel hotyalinai atyahitere xahita hiyeta nokaxolatyaki exe kamatiherahi kakoa — nexa.

Hatyaoseta nehenaha ihiye: — Maisa babera kaokare womana Judéia koa nalitare hitahi akiti. Exahe maisa wihinaeharenai hatyo nalita kaokehenaha hoka xakaiye wihiye hitahi akiti, exahe maisa iraeharetyareha hekoti hiso.
Xakore hoka wasema waokowita hiyahekola. Hiyaiya, wasemita atyo hakakoare hatyo hisaoniteraho kakoa kahalakoahare ahitere tahi akiti taita — nexaha ihiye.

Hatyaoseta aimenekotyaha haxahalakoatyakakoaneha ferakene Paulo kakoa. Hatyaoseta exaimenekolaha ferakenehena hoka kahareha xaneha Paulo tyaonitere nali. Witita hoka heko maka ihiye haxakaihakala ihiyeha kakoa hoka awaiyekehalakatya enomanaha wenati Enore koamaniya tahi akiti. Moisés xaotyakiraho, iraeti xakaisaseharenai xairala harenai tahi kakoa awaiyekehalakatya enomanaha hoka hotikisa Jesus tahi akiti enomanaha. — Hiyaiya, hatyo atyo Enore Kalorexe Aohenere — nexa ihiyeha, aiyateretyoa exahitaha.
Haiyaharenai atyo tyakeko iniraene hoka haiyaharenai atyo maisa tyakekota iniraene.

Hatyaoseta tyotya xanehenahitaha enonita hoka hatyo kakoa makere irae kakoaha. Xanehenahitehenere nahitita Paulo nexa ihiyeha: — Aliterexe nika Isekohaliti Waiyexe kaxaihakoretya Isaías hoka iraeta xahetakomaniyereharenai hiye.
Hiyaiya, exakere atyo nexa:

content.text: Hiyanehena hoka hexa judeunai hiye: Xasemenite, xakore hoka maisaite waiyekehalakita xomana. Xawahakotyaite, xiyaiyenite xakore hoka maisaite waiyekehalakita xomana.

Hiyaiya, hatyo halitinai xahekola atyo maisa waiyexe. Jihotyahita hatanakoakonaeha, exahe jihotyahitaha haxosenaeha. Ikoiya awa nikare tyaonahitaha hoka haxosenaiha kakoaiya waiyehenahitaha, exahe hatanakoakonaiha kakoaiya semahita hoka waiyekehalakaiya enomanaha. Hoka tyaohenahitahaiya nokoamaniye hoka naiyatelikihenahiteniya, nexa Enore.

content: Hatyoseta Paulo halakihena hairaene hoka nexa: — Xasemehena, Enore atyo axikatya Iraeti Waiyexe majudeuneharenai ana kaiyakehenahitaha maheta. Hoka semahenite hoka aokahenite haomanaha — nexa ihiyeha.
Hatyaoseta semaha iniraene hoka xanehenahitaha. Hoka hatyo kakoaha makere kinatyaxa irae kakoaha.
Hatyo najikinita hinama terehokoane Paulo tyaona hati axehenere ako. Hoka kahare haiyaharenai xane waiyitene hatyo nali.
Xakaita ihiyeha Enore koamaniya nawenatyaka tahi akiti, exahe Xekohaseti Jesus Cristo tahi hare xakaita ihiyeha hamamairanenehare kakoita. Maisa xala hare mahokoanityare iniraine.
